_about: Changing backend doors (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) that carry no @CheckPolicies, each with the reason (content-factory-next-fn33.90.2). tests/roles-matrix.guard.test.cjs reads it; the list may only shrink. A reason that starts with OPEN is a door whose role is not decided yet.
